resume_policy: No automatic resume. Explicit hash-bound owner resume only after reconciliation; never retry an intent.
empty_recovery_policy: Keep C with verified_texts empty plus unresolved/limits; no invented successful recovery. Report the no-recovery stratum separately.
H1_primary: delta micro F1 C-B on 14 fixed determinate units; all unusable outputs retained as coverage failures
H2_primary: delta personally adjudicated unsupported-claim count C-B, strict cited/recovered policy; all raw outputs including rejected reports

statistics.multiplicity: Two primary conditional tests: Holm adjustment reported alongside raw p; no automatic hypothesis acceptance
statistics.limitations: Purposive small sample, common author, clustered mechanisms; p-values conditional on exchangeability, no population/causal conclusion

completion.operational: 16 A records + 32 attempted terminal B/C records, intact checkpoints, no critical stop
completion.scientific: Operational completion plus personally approved references and complete hash-bound claim adjudication; performance does not gate completion
